properties.description:
.github/workflows/dependencies.yml, built 2026-10-02 in the PR that also raises rust-version to 1.98.

- `currency` job: tools/dependency_currency.py reads every Cargo.toml dependency (workspace and crate tables, dev and build), every `uses:` in the workflows and the declared rust-version.
  - It compares them with crates.io's sparse index, GitHub releases and the stable channel.
  - It FAILS on anything behind a new major or 0.x series with no hold in dependency-holds.toml, on a hold past its look_again date, on a hold with no reason, and on a lookup it could not make.
  - It REPORTS a newer release inside a declared range (lock refresh owed) and a hold whose bump has landed.
  - The dated report goes to the run summary and an artifact.
- `floor` job: builds the workspace, every target, at the declared rust-version.
- Triggers: monthly cron, manual dispatch, and any PR touching a manifest, the lockfile, a workflow, the holds file or the checker. A cut's step 1 changes Cargo.toml, so every cut runs it.
- Pinned by tools/test_dependency_currency.py (12 hermetic cases, mutation-checked), run in ci.yml's core gates.
properties.name: Every dependency, GitHub Action and the Rust floor is checked against its latest release monthly and before every cut, and anything behind a new series without a dated, reasoned hold fails the run
